```yaml
name: ADR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'include/**'
      - 'docs/adr/**'

jobs:
  adr-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Get changed files
      id: get_changed_files
      uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        format: json
        filter: '^(src|include)/.*\.cpp$'

    - name: Check for ADR changes
      run: |
        CHANGED_FILES=$(echo "${{ steps.get_changed_files.outputs.added_modified }}" | jq -r '.[]')
        ADR_FILES=$(find docs/adr -type f -name '*.md' | tr '\n' ' ')
        for FILE in $CHANGED_FILES; do
          if [[ ! " $ADR_FILES " =~ " $FILE " ]]; then
            echo "::error::Changes were made to $FILE but no ADR was updated."
            exit 1
          fi
        done

    - name: Generate ADR
      id: generate_adr
      uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
      with:
        model: gpt-4
        agent: adr-generator
        share: false
        prompt: |
          You are the ADR Generator agent. Your task is to review the changes made to the codebase and determine if any new ADRs need to be created. If so, please write the ADR following the format, numbering, and status conventions in docs/adr/README.md. If no new ADR is required, simply respond with a comment explaining why.
          Changes made:
          ${CHANGED_FILES}
        use_github_token: true

    - name: Comment on PR
      uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
      with:
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        message: |
          ### ADR Review

          The following ADRs have been generated based on the changes made to the codebase:

          ${{ steps.generate_adr.outputs.output }}

          Please review these ADRs and submit them as part of your PR.
        pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```
